mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of ivermectin and increase GI permeability, potentially elevating ivermectin levels; additionally, NSAIDs can cause GI irritation that may be compounded by ivermectin.
action: Monitor for increased ivermectin adverse effects (dizziness, tremor, ataxia); consider alternative analgesic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and GI protection.
